title: Avatar
description: A person or entity shown as a photo, or as initials on a soft tint when there is no photo. Also an empty seat: "+" to add someone, "?" for someone not added yet.

name.description: Used for initials, the tint and the accessible name.

src.description: Image URL. Initials show while it loads and if it fails.

alt.description: Accessible name; defaults to name. Pass "" when the name is already visible next to the avatar.

shape.description: square follows the brand's button radius (capped at 30%).

tint.description: Initials colour. auto hashes name (case- and space-insensitive) into brand, accent, info, warning or success, so a person keeps their colour everywhere; danger is never auto-picked. none is an untinted neutral. Every option is a background/foreground pair the theme engine contrast-checks.

placeholder.description: An empty seat: a dashed circle with "+" (add) or "?" (unknown, e.g. not added yet) in text.subtle. Ignores src and tint; still named by alt ?? name.

fallback.description: Rendered instead of this node by a client that doesn't know its type. Must be a node that client knows.

x-strata-rule.message: An Avatar needs props.name or props.alt. alt "" marks it decorative (the name is shown next to it), and still needs name for the initials.
